candidates.headline: AI slop videos aimed at babies are 'garbage,' says pediatrician
candidates.excerpt: Pediatrician criticizes low-quality AI-generated content targeting infants, raising concerns about developmental impact and content quality standards.
candidates.comedy_angle: AI companies optimizing for engagement over developmental safety—the perfect setup for Cody's 'we shipped it' energy meeting Sakura's regulatory exasperation.

candidates.headline: Top Programmers Return to Hand-Coding Amid AI Tool Doubts
candidates.excerpt: Senior developers report reverting to manual coding practices, citing reliability and control concerns with AI-assisted development tools.
candidates.comedy_angle: The AI hype cycle's inevitable backlash—perfect for Deep's 'I told you so' moment and Chloe's skepticism about productivity claims.

candidates.headline: Why Every AI-Coded App Is an Island
candidates.excerpt: Analysis of fragmentation and integration challenges in AI-generated codebases, highlighting technical debt and maintainability issues.
candidates.comedy_angle: AI-generated code as technical debt archipelago—ripe for Chloe's infrastructure rants and Cody's 'we'll fix it later' dismissal.

candidates.headline: Claude Opus 4.6 vs. Opus 4.7 Effort Levels and Prompt Steering Benchmarks
candidates.excerpt: Detailed benchmark comparison of Anthropic's latest model versions, analyzing effort levels and prompt steering capabilities.
candidates.comedy_angle: Incremental model updates as performance theater—setup for Cody's hype machine vs. Sakura's 'show me the actual gains' skepticism.

candidates.headline: Has AI Changed the Course of Drug Development? Three Years Later
candidates.excerpt: Retrospective analysis of AI's actual impact on pharmaceutical R&D, comparing hype from 2023 to measurable outcomes in 2026.
candidates.comedy_angle: AI's pharma promises vs. reality check—ideal for Mistral's regulatory caution and Cody's 'we're disrupting healthcare' overconfidence.

candidates.headline: Hash anchors and Myers diff and single-token anchors: 60% cheaper AI code edits
candidates.excerpt: Technical optimization reducing token costs for AI-assisted code editing through novel anchoring and diff strategies.
candidates.comedy_angle: Cost optimization as the unsexy follow-up to AI hype—niche appeal for Deep's infrastructure obsession.

candidates.headline: Octopal: Powerful AI agents without blind trust
candidates.excerpt: New AI agent framework emphasizing transparency and control mechanisms to reduce black-box decision-making risks.
candidates.comedy_angle: Yet another 'trustworthy AI' startup—perfect for Sakura's eye-roll at safety theater and Cody's product-launch enthusiasm.

candidates.headline: The AI Question That No AI Person Asks [video]
candidates.excerpt: Video essay exploring a fundamental question about AI that industry practitioners tend to avoid or overlook.
candidates.comedy_angle: Meta-commentary on AI industry blind spots—setup for Lana's philosophical jabs and the cast's collective 'we don't talk about that' moment.
